audit_mode: read-only code and artifact audit; no GPU work and no running-job mutation

verdict.matched_s3_s4_comparison: valid under the declared target-only production input and development protocol
material_optimization_risks: The exact reducer gives every observed target/quantile element equal weight, not every window, series, dataset, domain, or benchmark configuration.

KD weight 4 is a strongly KD-dominated and strongly gradient-clipped initialization regime for this randomly initialized architecture; it is not approximately one-third teacher pressure at initialization.
RoPE removes untrained absolute-position rows, but no production or development example is longer than 8192 while 18.13% of short55 and 45.37% of MV19 requests are longer than 8192.

Development validation is target-history-only while final multivariate evaluation enables available past-only covariates; a separate real-data covariate diagnostic is required before finalist promotion.
Plateau bookkeeping compares each small improvement with the immediately updated best score, so several individually sub-threshold improvements cannot accumulate into one material improvement.
A compatible-code/config change can currently be resumed from a checkpoint without proving equality to the originating attempt's full training fingerprint.

source_and_target_alignment.teacher_identity: the same dataset row and context_end identities stored in checksummed cache shards

missingness.history: pinned TimesFM-3 leading-trim-equivalent fixed-width representation plus per-row linear interpolation; remaining leading padding is masked
missingness.target: torch.isfinite(target), applied to GT and KD reductions
missingness.extreme_series: conditional per-variate range preconditioning was verified finite through exact updates 1-34

cross_request_grouping.variate_attention_scope: only channels within one source example
cross_request_grouping.logical_batch_behavior: different corpora are separate physical forwards whose gradients are accumulated before one optimizer update

mixed_microbatch_reduction.physical_loss: mean over finite target positions and all nine quantiles
mixed_microbatch_reduction.accumulation_weight: finite target positions in microbatch / finite target positions in logical batch
mixed_microbatch_reduction.epoch_tail_policy: one smaller final logical batch preserving all examples

learning_rate.note: The rate is updated after each optimizer step, so the final update uses the step-49999 rate rather than exactly the declared minimum; the difference is negligible.

validation.aggregation: unweighted geometric mean over 77 datasets, with additional true-MV terms

known_confirmation_failure.impact: The current validator divides by zero for an empty per-dataset confirmation partition. Fix or explicitly exclude these manifest-declared unavailable confirmation datasets before confirmation evaluation; this does not affect the running development screens.

evaluation_parity.note: Final teacher and student can receive the same available fields, but the frozen teacher cache and screen development inputs are target-history-only.

exact_training_gradient_mass.definition: The current scalar reducer is proportional to the count of finite [window,variate,horizon] targets; all examples have the same nine quantiles, so the quantile factor cancels in the reported fractions.

context_and_horizon_coverage.position_representation: RoPE; no learned absolute position rows
context_and_horizon_coverage.horizon_support_verdict: supported and trained through the required maximum

optimization_evidence.interpretation: S4 remains a legitimate strong-KD screen, but its stated one-third-pressure rationale does not describe the randomly initialized compact model. Use the step-5000 checkpoint counters to quantify whether clipping remains saturated before promoting the recipe.

checkpoint_and_resume.best_checkpoint: state_dict only, written at step zero and whenever development score strictly improves
checkpoint_and_resume.sequence_reconstruction: deterministic from training seed, epoch, and batch offset
resume_checks_present: resume file SHA against preceding attempt
resume_checks_missing: maximum steps and learning-rate schedule parameters
checkpoint_and_resume.required_operational_rule: Do not change any compatible training/model/config input before resuming S3/S4. Add an originating full-input fingerprint to future resume payloads before relying on cross-commit continuation.

predeclared_s5_balancing_probe.status: proposal_only; not implemented and running jobs unchanged
predeclared_s5_balancing_probe.protocol_note: The frozen v1.1 registry currently reserves S5 for representation-assisted KD. Using this proposal requires an explicit versioned protocol/registry amendment before inspecting later candidate metrics.
predeclared_s5_balancing_probe.hypothesis: Equal-window reduction plus bounded target-blind inverse-domain weights improves broad development forecasting because the current observed-element reducer overweights high-variate, long-horizon Nature/MV windows.
predeclared_s5_balancing_probe.base_objective_rule: At the first common step-5000 evaluation, use whichever of S3 compact_gt or S4 compact_kd4 has the lower frozen balanced_forecast_error; break an exact tie in favor of compact_gt.
predeclared_s5_balancing_probe.per_window_loss: For each window and each active objective component, average over that window's finite target variates, horizons, and nine quantiles. Then reduce windows with the target-blind domain weights below.
predeclared_s5_balancing_probe.domain_weight_rule: Let p_d be the outer-training window fraction and D=7. raw_w_d=clip((1/D)/p_d, 0.5, 2.0). Normalize raw_w_d to unit mean over outer-training windows. This caps the pre-normalization domain-weight ratio at 4x.
predeclared_s5_balancing_probe.activation_gate_at_step5000: For each domain, geometrically aggregate across its datasets the step5000/step0 ratios for student pinball and normalized median MAE. Activate only if the geometric mean ratio over Econ/Fin, Energy, Healthcare, Sales, and Web/CloudOps is at least 1.03 times the ratio over Nature and Transport, and at least one compact candidate improved its overall balanced_forecast_error from step zero.
predeclared_s5_balancing_probe.comparison: Same compact architecture, seeded initialization, outer-training identities/order, optimizer, schedule, precision, 50000-step ceiling, development partition, and deployment policy as the selected S3/S4 base; only the loss reducer/domain weights differ.

required_actions_before_later_gates: At step 5000, read the resume checkpoint counters and development curve once; quantify clipping and the predeclared domain-learning gate.
Do not change training/model/config inputs if either running job must resume from its current checkpoint.
Fix empty confirmation-partition handling before finalist confirmation evaluation.
Refresh the covariate-development diagnostic's stale student-config SHA (it declares a1ab799d..., while the audited compact config is a6a9d4c...) before running that diagnostic.
Measure final GIFT quality and latency on the same selected checkpoint and deployment configuration.
